scope: Camera Director V2 focused validation only; no full legacy regressions

tests.detail: Renderer, shader, theme version declarations identical
heightAt, footprintHeight, demWeight, demNormal, linearize, encode, lum, grade, terrainMaterial, terrainOutput are byte identical
All region material, sea, proxy/DEM light, baked suppression, output transfer, clipping code after source sampling is byte identical
All actual geo, projection basis, crop UV, geographic coverage computation before optional source block identical
Exact source expression retained in context disabled or terrainLodWeight>=1 branch
Both real texture sources sampled at same geographic coordinates and mixed as raw source RGB before linearization / frozen material / lighting
Only actual raster source input added to same terrain fragment
DEM 2x parameters, corrected lighting uniforms, reveal, terrain/glow/boundary/marker/text render ordering unchanged
Approved records iterated first and unchanged; context additions deduplicate existing IDs and normalize only extra geographic context records
Default factory has no new texture fetch and context source disabled; V1 source modules unchanged

detail.limitation: Conservative full-frame jump screen, not a perceptual proof

detail.note: Small encoder differences allowed; Camera diagnostics test exact lock separately

geographicAlignedResidual.method: Area-downsampled H.264 RGB frames, inverse geographic extent warp, bilinear preceding-frame sampling, central view excluding fixed disclosure
limitations: Lossy H.264 and area resampling contribute to residual
MSAA GIS edges contribute to residual
Scale-dependent DEM footprint changes contribute to residual
Metrics do not independently establish perceived camera quality
